capabilities: view images with zoom, pan, rotate, invert, and a thumbnail gallery
download remote HTTP(S) images into the vault so notes work offline
store images in a SHA-256 content-addressed media folder and rewrite links
find and trash unused (orphan) images not referenced anywhere
convert wiki image embeds to Markdown links vault-wide
extras: The README repeatedly warns that image processing edits note text with no plugin-level undo and recommends backing up the vault (Git, filesystem, or Obsidian Sync) before running; batch orphan deletion is opt-in and reversible only via the trash. Beta installation is via BRAT.
intentEvidence: the image viewer part of this plugin is based on that great work
motivation: The author lists three failure modes of image handling in Obsidian: remote images disappearing, attachments scattering across folders, and the same picture saved under different names.
problem: Remote images vanish when hosts die, attachments scatter across folders, and identical pictures get saved multiple times, with no tooling to keep image storage clean.

relations.evidence: Special thanks to sissilab's marvelous Obsidian Image Toolkit; the image viewer part of this plugin is based on that great work.

summary: Image viewer and manager that adds zoom/pan viewing plus automatic local download, SHA-256 deduplication, orphan cleanup, and wikilink conversion.
